what: Clicking a header nav item raises a rounded white large menu panel below in .3s (on phone width it rises together from 30px lower), with a 30px square arrow rotated 45° pointing down attached at the center of the clicked item. The screen below the header is covered by a pale green veil (.9) in .4s. Clicking another item swaps to that panel and raises it again, and the same item, the veil, close or Esc dismisses it in .3s. Document scroll is locked while it is open
ease: cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1)(panel, jquery.transit default ease) · power1.out(curtain, jQuery fadeIn’s swing→easeOutQuad)

options.dur: Duration of the panel appearing and disappearing (sec), default .3
options.rise: Distance (px) the panel rises at phone width (under 767px), default 30
options.lock: 0 means scroll is not locked while opening

use:
Menu 1Menu 2
…
…
note: The panel sits directly below the part element (top: 100%), so give the part element a position. The mask is laid fixed from the bottom edge of the part element to the end of the screen. It fires fx:open and fx:close on open and close

from.where: shared.js header .gnav (original template.js showMegaMenu/hideMegaMenu — transit opacity 300ms, #default-header-mask fadeIn/fadeOut, .menu-arrow 45°)
